# Moss Docs

> Moss is a high-performance runtime for real-time semantic search. It delivers sub-10 ms lookups, instant index updates, and zero infra overhead. Moss runs where your agent lives - cloud, in-browser, or on-device - so search feels native and users never wait.

- [Moss documentation](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/index.md): Set up Moss semantic search with SDK quickstarts, core concepts, integration guides, and API reference for conversational AI.
- [Moss Inference](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/inference/overview.md): Run optimized LLM inference alongside retrieval on the same host, delivering sub-200ms inference latency so your agent can start responding sooner.
- [Quickstart](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/inference/quickstart.md): Call the moss model, stream the reply, then ground it in your own index.
- [Models](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/inference/models.md): Every model Moss Inference serves, with its prompt limit, prices, routes and the parameters it refuses.
- [Pricing](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/inference/pricing.md): How Moss Inference bills: credits, tokens, prompt caching, retrievals, browser tasks and your own vendor key.
- [OpenAI compatibility](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/inference/openai-compatibility.md): Call Moss Inference from any OpenAI client: base URL, key, endpoints, Moss headers and what differs from OpenAI.
- [Ground answers in your indexes](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/inference/retrieval.md): Choose the indexes Moss searches, turn the search off, and see what it costs and how long it takes.
- [Streaming](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/inference/streaming.md): Stream replies as Responses events or Chat Completions chunks, stop early, and catch errors after the stream starts.
- [Tool calling](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/inference/tool-calling.md): Give the model function tools, run each call in your code, and send the results back.
- [MCP servers](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/inference/mcp-servers.md): Name an MCP server in tools, and Moss runs its tools for the model during the response.
- [Moss search tool](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/inference/moss-search.md): Give the model a moss_search tool, and Moss searches your project's indexes each time the model asks.
- [Bring your own key](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/inference/bring-your-own-key.md): Run vendor models on your own OpenAI, Anthropic or Google key, with the same search of your indexes.
- [Tasks](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/inference/tasks.md): Tasks are asynchronous agent runs hosted by Moss. Each task defines a goal, a cloud browser environment, and configurable limits on runtime and cost, allowing agents to execute workflows independently of your application.
- [SDKs](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/inference/sdks.md): The inference client in each Moss SDK, with its package and minimum version.
- [Python](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/inference/sdks/python.md): The Python client for Moss Inference: OpenAI's Responses API, answered from your indexes.
- [JavaScript](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/inference/sdks/javascript.md): The JavaScript client for Moss Inference: OpenAI's Responses API, answered from your indexes.
- [Browser](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/inference/sdks/browser.md): The browser client for Moss Inference: OpenAI's Responses API, answered from your indexes.
- [Swift](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/inference/sdks/swift.md): The Swift client for Moss Inference: OpenAI's Responses API, answered from your indexes.
- [Android](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/inference/sdks/android.md): The Android client for Moss Inference: OpenAI's Responses API, answered from your indexes.
- [Elixir](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/inference/sdks/elixir.md): The Elixir client for Moss Inference: OpenAI's Responses API, answered from your indexes.
- [C](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/inference/sdks/c.md): The C client for Moss Inference: OpenAI's Responses API, answered from your indexes.
- [Errors and limits](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/inference/errors-and-limits.md): Rate and size limits, every error status and code, and when to retry.
- [What is Moss?](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/start/what-is-moss.md): Real-time semantic search that runs where your agent lives
- [SDK Quickstart](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/start/quickstart.md): Install, authenticate, create an index, and query it (JS/Python tabs)
- [Core Concepts](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/start/core-concepts.md): Indexes, embeddings, retrieval, sessions, sync, and the rest of the Moss model.
- [Vibecoding with Moss](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/start/vibecoding.md): Starter prompts, LLM-friendly docs, and MCP setup for building Moss-powered apps with AI coding tools.
- [Real-Time Local Indexing](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/build/real-time-local-indexing.md): Index and query in-process with a local session - no per-operation network call.
- [Live-Call Context](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/build/live-call-context.md): Query a persistent cloud index and a live session together during a conversation.
- [Data Hydration & Sync](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/build/data-hydration-sync.md): Hydrate on-device indexes from the cloud and keep them fresh with zero-downtime hot-swaps.
- [Cross-Agent Context & Omni-Channel Handoff](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/build/cross-agent-handoff.md): Hand a conversation off across agents, channels, and devices with full context intact.
- [Sub-10ms Knowledge Retrieval](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/build/offline-first-search.md): Load an index into memory and run semantic queries in-process.
- [Voice Agent (LiveKit)](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/build/voice-agent-livekit.md): Ground a LiveKit voice agent in your Moss index for real-time retrieval.
- [Agent Context](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/build/agent-context.md): Persist and recall agent context as documents in a Moss index.
- [Browser Extension Context](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/build/browser-extension-context.md): Run indexing and queries in the browser with the @moss-dev/moss-web SDK.
- [Electron App Local Search](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/build/electron-local-search.md): Run a Moss index in the Electron main process and query it from the renderer over IPC.
- [Local Embeddings](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/build/local-embeddings.md): Embed documents on-device with a built-in model.
- [Moss SDK authentication](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/integrate/authentication.md): Configure project credentials for the Moss SDKs
- [Indexing Data](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/integrate/indexing-data.md): Prepare and upsert your content into Moss indexes
- [Sessions](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/integrate/sessions.md): Local-first, real-time indexing with create-resume-query-push.
- [Retrieval](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/integrate/retrieval.md): Choose vector, keyword, or hybrid retrieval
- [Hybrid Search](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/integrate/hybrid-search.md): Choose semantic-only, keyword-only, or blended retrieval in Moss with the alpha setting and tune it to your query intent.
- [Metadata Filtering](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/integrate/metadata-filtering.md): Narrow query results to documents whose metadata matches a filter, date ranges included.
- [Custom Embeddings](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/integrate/custom-embeddings.md): Provide your own embeddings for Moss indexes and queries instead of using a built-in on-device model.
- [Multi-Index Search](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/integrate/multi-index-search.md): Search several loaded Moss indexes in one request and combine matches into a global top-K result set.
- [Storage & Persistence](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/integrate/storage-persistence.md): Persist loaded indexes to disk and keep them in sync with the cloud.
- [Memory Sizing](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/integrate/memory-sizing.md): Estimate the memory a server process needs for the embedding model and its loaded indexes, and keep it bounded with many indexes.
- [Releasing Resources](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/integrate/releasing-resources.md): Close clients and sessions to free local memory promptly, and close idle clients in apps that search in bursts.
- [Deployment / Production](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/integrate/deployment-production.md): Checklist for shipping Moss-backed features
- [Errors & Troubleshooting](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/reference/errors.md): Reference for common Moss SDK errors and how to fix them
- [Telemetry](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/reference/telemetry.md): What the Moss SDKs send to Moss, when they send it, and what never leaves your device.
- [Pricing & Limits](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/pricing.md): Plans, credits, limits, and usage rates for Moss.
- [SDK Overview](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/reference/sdk.md): Every Moss SDK capability, with links to the detailed guide for each.
- [Licensing](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/reference/licensing.md): The license of each Moss SDK, native library, release binary, tool and integration, and where each one keeps its terms.
- [Moss Python SDK overview](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/reference/python/api.md): Everything the Moss Python SDK can do, with a snippet for each operation.
- [Index from Files (Python SDK)](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/reference/python/files.md): Create a Moss index from PDF and DOCX files in Python with server-side text extraction and configurable parsing.
- [Web Sources (Python SDK)](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/reference/python/web-sources.md): Create and resync website sources in the Moss Python SDK to keep searchable index content current.
- [Sessions (Python SDK)](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/reference/python/sessions.md): Index and query locally in real time with a SessionIndex, then push to the cloud.
- [Hybrid search (Python SDK)](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/reference/python/hybrid-search.md): Configure hybrid semantic and keyword search with the alpha parameter in the Moss Python SDK.
- [Metadata filtering (Python SDK)](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/reference/python/metadata-filtering.md): Narrow query results to documents whose metadata matches a filter.
- [Exact / Graph Retrieval (Python SDK)](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/reference/python/graph-retrieval.md): Deterministic fetch by id or metadata, sorting, and parent grouping on a session.
- [Custom embeddings (Python SDK)](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/reference/python/custom-embeddings.md): Use caller-provided document and query embeddings with cloud indexes and sessions in the Moss Python SDK.
- [Structured payload](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/reference/python/structured-payload.md): Attach an opaque structured record to a document, stored and returned verbatim.
- [Multi-index search](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/reference/python/multi-index-search.md): Use the Moss Python SDK to load multiple indexes, query them together, and return a global top-K.
- [MossClient (Python SDK)](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/reference/python/classes/MossClient.md): Semantic search client for vector similarity operations.
- [SessionIndex (Python SDK)](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/reference/python/classes/SessionIndex.md): Local, in-session index for real-time indexing and querying.
- [JobHandle](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/reference/python/classes/JobHandle.md): Handle to an in-flight index build submitted with wait=False.
- [AddDocumentsOptions](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/reference/python/interfaces/AddDocumentsOptions.md): Python options controlling whether added documents update existing entries with matching IDs.
- [Chunking](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/reference/python/interfaces/Chunking.md): Options for the native chunker that splits text, markdown and document text into passages before indexing.
- [DocumentInfo (Python SDK)](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/reference/python/interfaces/DocumentInfo.md): Python document fields for IDs, searchable text, metadata, optional embeddings, and structured payloads stored without searching.
- [GetDocumentsOptions (Python SDK)](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/reference/python/interfaces/GetDocumentsOptions.md): Python deterministic document retrieval options for exact IDs, metadata filters, sorting, and grouping documents by parent.
- [IndexInfo (Python SDK)](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/reference/python/interfaces/IndexInfo.md): Python index information including identifier, name, version, build status, document count, timestamps, and embedding model.
- [IndexStatus](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/reference/python/interfaces/IndexStatus.md): Python index status values for indexes that have not started building, are building, are ready, or have failed.
- [InvalidArgumentError](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/reference/python/interfaces/InvalidArgumentError.md): The MossError subclass for INVALID_ARGUMENT, also a ValueError.
- [JobPhase (Python SDK)](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/reference/python/interfaces/JobPhase.md): Python job phase values for downloading, deserializing, generating embeddings, building indexes, uploading, and cleanup.
- [JobProgress (Python SDK)](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/reference/python/interfaces/JobProgress.md): Python job progress fields covering the job ID, status, progress value, and optional current phase.
- [JobStatus (Python SDK)](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/reference/python/interfaces/JobStatus.md): Python job status values for pending upload, uploading, building, completion, and failure.
- [JobStatusResponse (Python SDK)](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/reference/python/interfaces/JobStatusResponse.md): Python get_job_status response fields for progress, current phase, errors, and creation or completion timestamps.
- [LoadIndexesResult (Python SDK)](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/reference/python/interfaces/LoadIndexesResult.md): Python bulk index loading results with successfully loaded names and per-index failure messages and error codes.
- [ModelRef (Python SDK)](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/reference/python/interfaces/ModelRef.md): Python reference to an embedding model, with its model identifier and version.
- [MossError (Python SDK)](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/reference/python/interfaces/MossError.md): The exception raised for every failure the Moss native core reports.
- [MutationOptions (Python SDK)](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/reference/python/interfaces/MutationOptions.md): Python document mutation options for controlling upsert behavior when adding documents.
- [MutationResult (Python SDK)](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/reference/python/interfaces/MutationResult.md): Python result fields for index creation and document mutations: background job ID, index name, and document count.
- [ParentGrouping](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/reference/python/interfaces/ParentGrouping.md): Python configuration for grouping sibling documents by parent metadata and assembling them in a chosen order.
- [ParseFileInput (Python SDK)](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/reference/python/interfaces/ParseFileInput.md): Python PDF or DOCX input descriptor with a unique name, content type, and either a filesystem path or raw bytes.
- [ParseOptions (Python SDK)](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/reference/python/interfaces/ParseOptions.md): Python text extraction options for OCR, high-resolution processing, document segmentation, and merging tables across pages.
- [PushIndexResult (Python SDK)](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/reference/python/interfaces/PushIndexResult.md): Python result from persisting a local session index to the cloud, including job ID, index name, document count, and status.
- [QueryOptions (Python SDK)](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/reference/python/interfaces/QueryOptions.md): Python query options for embeddings, result count, hybrid weighting, metadata filters, grouping, and score controls.
- [QueryResultDocumentInfo (Python SDK)](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/reference/python/interfaces/QueryResultDocumentInfo.md): Python query result document fields for text, metadata, vector relevance score, source index, and stored structured payload.
- [SearchResult (Python SDK)](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/reference/python/interfaces/SearchResult.md): Python search response containing ranked result documents, the original query, source index name, and query timing.
- [Moss JavaScript SDK overview](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/reference/js/api.md): Everything the Moss JavaScript SDK can do, with a snippet for each operation.
- [Index from Files (JavaScript SDK)](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/reference/js/files.md): Create a Moss index from PDF and DOCX files in JavaScript with server-side text extraction and configurable parsing.
- [Web Sources (JavaScript SDK)](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/reference/js/web-sources.md): Create and resync website sources in the Moss JavaScript SDK to keep searchable index content current.
- [Sessions (JavaScript SDK)](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/reference/js/sessions.md): Local-first, real-time indexing in JavaScript with create-resume-query-push.
- [Hybrid search (JavaScript SDK)](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/reference/js/hybrid-search.md): Blend semantic and keyword scoring in JavaScript with a single alpha parameter.
- [Metadata filtering (JavaScript SDK)](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/reference/js/metadata-filtering.md): Narrow JavaScript query results to documents whose metadata matches a filter.
- [Custom embeddings (JavaScript SDK)](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/reference/js/custom-embeddings.md): Bring your own vectors in JavaScript instead of a built-in on-device model.
- [Custom Authenticator (JS)](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/reference/js/custom-authenticator.md): Authenticate browser/frontend clients (`@moss-dev/moss-web`) without shipping your projectKey.
- [MossClient (JavaScript SDK)](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/reference/js/classes/MossClient.md): Async-first semantic search client for vector similarity operations.
- [SessionIndex (JavaScript SDK)](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/reference/js/classes/SessionIndex.md): Local-first, in-process index for real-time indexing and querying.
- [CreateIndexFromFilesOptions](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/reference/js/interfaces/CreateIndexFromFilesOptions.md): JavaScript options for file-based index creation, including the embedding model, text extraction controls, and progress callbacks.
- [CreateIndexOptions](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/reference/js/interfaces/CreateIndexOptions.md): JavaScript index creation options for choosing an embedding model and receiving build progress updates.
- [DocumentInfo (JavaScript SDK)](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/reference/js/interfaces/DocumentInfo.md): JavaScript document fields for indexing and retrieval: ID, searchable text, metadata, and optional caller-provided embeddings.
- [GetDocumentsOptions (JavaScript SDK)](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/reference/js/interfaces/GetDocumentsOptions.md): JavaScript options for fetching selected document IDs or all documents from a Moss index.
- [IndexInfo (JavaScript SDK)](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/reference/js/interfaces/IndexInfo.md): JavaScript index information including build status, document count, timestamps, version, and embedding model.
- [JobProgress (JavaScript SDK)](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/reference/js/interfaces/JobProgress.md): JavaScript progress callback fields for an asynchronous job: job ID, status, progress, and current phase.
- [JobStatusResponse (JavaScript SDK)](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/reference/js/interfaces/JobStatusResponse.md): JavaScript getJobStatus response fields for job progress, current phase, errors, and creation or completion timestamps.
- [LoadIndexOptions](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/reference/js/interfaces/LoadIndexOptions.md): JavaScript index loading options for automatic refresh, polling intervals, and caching downloaded index data to disk.
- [LoadIndexesResult (JavaScript SDK)](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/reference/js/interfaces/LoadIndexesResult.md): JavaScript bulk index loading results, including loaded names and per-index failure messages and error codes.
- [LoadSessionOptions](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/reference/js/interfaces/LoadSessionOptions.md): JavaScript session index loading options for polling newer cloud versions and pausing refresh while local edits are pending.
- [ModelRef (JavaScript SDK)](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/reference/js/interfaces/ModelRef.md): JavaScript reference to an embedding model, with its model identifier and version.
- [MossError (JavaScript SDK)](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/reference/js/interfaces/MossError.md): An Error with a stable code, from the native core or the SDK.
- [MutationOptions (JavaScript SDK)](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/reference/js/interfaces/MutationOptions.md): JavaScript document mutation options for upserting matching IDs and receiving asynchronous progress callbacks.
- [MutationResult (JavaScript SDK)](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/reference/js/interfaces/MutationResult.md): JavaScript result fields returned after index creation or document mutations complete: job ID, index name, and document count.
- [ParseFileInput (JavaScript SDK)](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/reference/js/interfaces/ParseFileInput.md): JavaScript file input fields for PDF and DOCX parsing, using a file path or in-memory bytes with a unique name and content type.
- [ParseOptions (JavaScript SDK)](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/reference/js/interfaces/ParseOptions.md): JavaScript text extraction options for OCR, high-resolution processing, document segmentation, and merging tables across pages.
- [PushIndexResult (JavaScript SDK)](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/reference/js/interfaces/PushIndexResult.md): JavaScript cloud persistence result for a session index, including background job ID, index name, document count, and status.
- [QueryOptions (JavaScript SDK)](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/reference/js/interfaces/QueryOptions.md): JavaScript query controls for embeddings, result count, hybrid weighting, metadata filters, score thresholds, and candidate depth.
- [QueryResultDocumentInfo (JavaScript SDK)](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/reference/js/interfaces/QueryResultDocumentInfo.md): JavaScript query result document fields, including searchable text, metadata, vector relevance score, and source index name.
- [RefreshResult](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/reference/js/interfaces/RefreshResult.md): JavaScript index refresh result fields showing previous and new update timestamps and whether cloud changes were applied.
- [SearchResult (JavaScript SDK)](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/reference/js/interfaces/SearchResult.md): JavaScript search response containing ranked documents, the original query, source index name, and query timing.
- [FilterCondition](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/reference/js/type-aliases/FilterCondition.md): JavaScript metadata condition shapes for equality, ranges, membership, and proximity; this shape is documented but not exported.
- [ISODate](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/reference/js/type-aliases/ISODate.md): JavaScript string type representing an ISO 8601 date, with an example timestamp.
- [JobPhase (JavaScript SDK)](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/reference/js/type-aliases/JobPhase.md): JavaScript job phase values for downloading, deserializing, generating embeddings, building indexes, uploading, and cleanup.
- [JobStatus (JavaScript SDK)](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/reference/js/type-aliases/JobStatus.md): JavaScript job status values for pending upload, uploading, building, completion, and failure.
- [MetadataFilter](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/reference/js/type-aliases/MetadataFilter.md): JavaScript metadata filter shapes for local queries, with field conditions and logical composition; this shape is not exported.
- [MossErrorCode](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/reference/js/type-aliases/MossErrorCode.md): The stable code on every error from the native core, and on the SDK errors that set a code.
- [MossModel](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/reference/js/type-aliases/MossModel.md): JavaScript embedding model choices: moss-minilm, moss-mediumlm, or custom for caller-provided document and query embeddings.
- [isMossError](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/reference/js/functions/isMossError.md): Narrows a caught value to a MossError with a stable code.
- [Moss Swift SDK overview](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/reference/swift/api.md): On-device semantic search for iOS with the Moss Swift SDK.
- [Querying](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/reference/swift/querying.md): Hybrid search and metadata filtering with the Moss Swift SDK.
- [Exact / Graph Retrieval (Swift SDK)](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/reference/swift/graph-retrieval.md): Deterministic fetch by id or metadata, typed filters, parent grouping, and verbatim payloads with the Moss Swift SDK.
- [Custom Authenticator](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/reference/swift/custom-authenticator.md): Authenticate the Swift client with short-lived tokens from your backend.
- [MossClient (Swift SDK)](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/reference/swift/classes/MossClient.md): Entry point for the Swift SDK: construct the client and open on-device sessions.
- [MossSession](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/reference/swift/classes/MossSession.md): On-device index for local embedding, search, persistence, and cloud sync.
- [Moss Swift SDK types](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/reference/swift/types.md): Structs and enums used across the Moss Swift SDK.
- [Android SDK Overview](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/reference/android/getting-started.md): On-device semantic search for Android with the Moss Android SDK.
- [Moss Elixir SDK overview](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/reference/elixir/api.md): On-device semantic search for Elixir with the Moss Elixir SDK.
- [Moss.Client](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/reference/elixir/classes/Client.md): Entry point for cloud index management and local querying in the Moss Elixir SDK.
- [Moss.Session](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/reference/elixir/classes/Session.md): Local in-session index for real-time embedding, search, and cloud sync.
- [Moss Elixir SDK types](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/reference/elixir/types.md): Structs passed to and returned from the Moss Elixir SDK.
- [Moss Browser SDK overview](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/reference/browser/api.md): Private, in-browser semantic search for the web with the Moss Browser/WASM SDK.
- [Browser vs Node](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/reference/browser/browser-vs-node.md): Choose between the Moss Browser/WASM SDK and the Node SDK.
- [MossClient (Browser SDK)](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/reference/browser/classes/MossClient.md): In-browser semantic search client backed by WebAssembly.
- [Moss C SDK overview](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/reference/c/getting-started.md): Semantic search in C with libmoss, the native Moss runtime.
- [API reference](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/reference/c/api.md): MossClient and MossSession functions, memory management, and error handling for libmoss.
- [Examples](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/reference/c/examples.md): Runnable libmoss programs: session workflow, cloud CRUD, and metadata filtering.
- [LiveKit](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/integrations/livekit.md): Add a persistent knowledge base and per-call conversation memory to a LiveKit voice agent with Moss search function tools.
- [Pipecat](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/integrations/pipecat.md): Add Moss retrieval to a Pipecat voice pipeline with pipecat-moss. One processor searches your index on each user turn and hands the passages to the LLM.
- [VAPI](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/integrations/vapi.md): Connect Moss semantic search to VAPI voice agents via a Custom Knowledge Base webhook.
- [ElevenLabs](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/integrations/elevenlabs.md): Add real-time knowledge base access to ElevenLabs Conversational AI agents with Moss semantic search.
- [Agora](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/integrations/agora.md): Add real-time knowledge base access to Agora Conversational AI voice agents with Moss semantic search over MCP.
- [Voice Agents](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/voice-agents/voice-agents.md): Build and deploy AI voice agents with Moss
- [Vercel AI SDK](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/integrations/vercel-ai-sdk.md): Give AI agents semantic search capabilities using Moss tools for the Vercel AI SDK.
- [LangChain](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/integrations/langchain.md): Use Moss as a retriever in LangChain chains and agents for sub-10ms semantic search.
- [DSPy](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/integrations/dspy.md): Use Moss as a retrieval module in DSPy programs.
- [Agno](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/integrations/agno.md): Use Moss as the in-memory semantic search runtime for Agno agents.
- [Mastra](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/integrations/mastra.md): Use Moss semantic search tools inside Mastra agents.
- [Strands Agents](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/integrations/strands-agents.md): Give Strands Agents sub-10ms semantic retrieval from a Moss knowledge base.
- [sim.ai](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/integrations/sim.md): Add sub-10ms semantic search to sim.ai workflows via a Moss-powered webhook tool.
- [MCP Server](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/integrations/mcp-server.md): Connect Moss semantic search to any MCP-compatible AI client - Claude Desktop, Cursor, VS Code, and more.
- [Moss CLI](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/integrations/moss-cli.md): Manage indexes, documents, and queries from the terminal
- [Next.js](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/integrations/nextjs.md): Add semantic search to a Next.js application using Moss with Server Actions.
- [VitePress](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/integrations/vitepress.md): Add semantic search to your VitePress documentation site with zero configuration using Moss.
- [Data Connectors](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/integrations/data-connectors.md): Sync rows from SQLite, MongoDB, MySQL, or Supabase into a Moss index.
- [Markdown Indexer](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/integrations/md-indexer.md): Build and upload a Moss search index from any Markdown or VitePress docs directory.
- [Grounded FAQ Agent](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/cookbook/langgraph.md): Use Moss as a retrieval node inside a LangGraph stateful agent graph for grounded, sub-10ms answers.
- [Multi-Agent Travel Planner](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/cookbook/crewai.md): Build a multi-agent travel planner where each specialist agent is backed by its own domain-isolated Moss index.
- [Customer Support Agent](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/cookbook/pydantic-ai.md): Expose Moss semantic search as a typed, reusable tool inside a Pydantic AI agent.
- [Generalist Voice Agent](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/cookbook/generalist-voice-agent.md): A LiveKit voice agent that routes calls to different Moss indexes based on persona — switch knowledge bases without touching code.
- [Mortgage Lending Agent](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/cookbook/mortgage-lending-agent.md): A two-agent voice assistant that hands off from mortgage Q&A to a structured payment flow, sharing session state across the switch.
- [Airline Customer Service Agent](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/cookbook/airline-customer-agent.md): An airline voice agent that uses ambient retrieval — Moss queries fire automatically before each LLM turn, with no retrieval tool and no extra round-trip.
- [Candidate Screening Agent](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/cookbook/candidate-screening-agent.md): A voice screening interviewer that grounds every question in two Moss indexes — one for the job description, one for the candidate's resume — and emits a structured scorecard.
- [Postgres Sync](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/cookbook/postgres-sync.md): Keep Moss in step with a Postgres table through an outbox, or move the table into Moss.
- [Introduction](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/api-reference/v1/getting-started/introduction.md): Base URL and overview for the Moss Control Plane API.
- [Moss REST API authentication](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/api-reference/v1/getting-started/authentication.md): How to authenticate requests to the Moss Control Plane API.
- [Overview](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/api-reference/v1/getting-started/overview.md): Control Plane endpoint structure and shared request schema.
- [Init Upload](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/api-reference/v1/index-management/initUpload.md): Get a presigned URL to upload the documents of a new index.
- [Start Build](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/api-reference/v1/index-management/startBuild.md): Trigger an index build after uploading data.
- [Get Job Status](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/api-reference/v1/index-management/getJobStatus.md): Check the status of an async index build job.
- [Get Index](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/api-reference/v1/index-management/getIndex.md): Fetch metadata for a single index.
- [List Indexes](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/api-reference/v1/index-management/listIndex.md): List every index tied to a project.
- [Delete Index](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/api-reference/v1/index-management/deleteIndex.md): Delete an index record and associated assets.
- [Create Web Source](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/api-reference/v1/web-sources/createWebSource.md): Crawl a website into an index, alone or alongside other sites.
- [List Web Sources](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/api-reference/v1/web-sources/listWebSources.md): Enumerate the project's web sources, optionally for one index.
- [Get Web Source](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/api-reference/v1/web-sources/getWebSource.md): Fetch a single web source by ID.
- [Resync Web Source](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/api-reference/v1/web-sources/resyncWebSource.md): Re-crawl a website and refresh its pages in the index.
- [Update Web Source](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/api-reference/v1/web-sources/updateWebSource.md): Change a web source's crawl settings or refresh schedule.
- [Delete Web Source](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/api-reference/v1/web-sources/deleteWebSource.md): Remove a web source and its pages from the index.
- [Add Documents](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/api-reference/v1/document-operations/addDocs.md): Append or upsert documents into an existing index.
- [Get Documents](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/api-reference/v1/document-operations/getDocs.md): Retrieve the stored documents for an index.
- [Delete Documents](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/api-reference/v1/document-operations/deleteDocs.md): Remove specific documents by ID and rebuild the index.
- [Chat Completions](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/api-reference/v1/inference/chat-completions.md): Reference for POST /v1/chat/completions: fields, headers, the response, the stream format and an example.
- [Responses](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/api-reference/v1/inference/responses.md): Reference for POST /v1/responses: fields, input items, events, the response and what is not supported.
- [Tasks](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/api-reference/v1/inference/tasks.md): Reference for the Tasks routes: create a task, get it, cancel it, and list or download its files.
- [List models](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/api-reference/v1/inference/models.md): Reference for GET /v1/models, which lists every model Moss Inference serves now.
- [Founding Agent overview](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/founding-agent/overview.md): A voice AI agent for your website that answers visitors, qualifies buyers, and books meetings.
- [Founding Agent quickstart](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/founding-agent/quickstart.md): Publish a working Founding Agent and talk to it in a few minutes.
- [Core concepts](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/founding-agent/concepts.md): The vocabulary of the Founding Agent: keys, knowledge, sessions, leads, handoff, and booking.
- [Create and configure an agent](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/founding-agent/portal/create-and-configure.md): Set up your Founding Agent in the portal: identity, voice, teaching, and deploy.
- [Teach your agent](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/founding-agent/portal/teach.md): Give your agent the knowledge it answers from: Q&A pairs and knowledge chunks.
- [Leads and conversations](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/founding-agent/portal/leads-and-conversations.md): Review conversations, read transcripts, and see what visitors ask.
- [Live calls and human handoff](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/founding-agent/portal/live-calls-and-handoff.md): Watch active calls and take over a conversation as a human when it matters.
- [Install and keys](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/founding-agent/embed/install-and-keys.md): Install the Founding Agent SDK and set up your publishable and API keys.
- [Server token route](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/founding-agent/embed/server-token-route.md): Mint a Founding Agent session from your server so your API key never reaches the browser.
- [React components](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/founding-agent/embed/react-components.md): Drop the Founding Agent voice UI onto your site with the React provider and bubble.
- [Demo booking](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/founding-agent/embed/booking.md): Let visitors book a demo by voice, backed by your Cal.com, Calendly or Google Calendar.
- [CRM](https://docs.moss.dev/docs/founding-agent/integrations/crm.md): Sync captured leads from your Founding Agent into HubSpot or Salesforce.
